_hinweis: Follow-up texts for step 3: the player gets in touch after a promise or with a transfer request (“Gaffer”, formal); the manager replies informally. The texts don't name the promise in detail and so fit any kind of promise. Placeholders: {spieler_kurz}.

standard: {spieler_kurz} says thanks
Gaffer, you kept your word. I won't forget that. I wanted to thank you for it.
Gaffer, just a quick word from me: you did what you said you would. That's not a given. Thanks.

egoist: Gaffer, you delivered what was agreed. Good. Now you can see what you have in me.
kumpel: Gaffer, you kept your promise, and I told the lads as much. You can be relied on. Thanks for that.
heisssporn: Gaffer, I'll admit I didn't believe it. You've proved me wrong. Respect.
vorbildprofi: Gaffer, thank you for keeping your promise. I'll repay it with performances.
diva: Gaffer, you did what you promised me. I expect that, but I appreciate it. That's how I like working with you.
anfuehrer: Gaffer, your word could be trusted. That gets around the dressing room, and it helps me keep the squad behind you.

standard: A deal is a deal. You've earned it.
That was the start. Now I want to see you back it up.
Don't thank me. Ease off and you're back out of the side.
Glad to hear it, gaffer. You can count on me.
Understood. I'll keep at it.
Fair enough. I just wanted to say it.
{spieler_kurz}: promise not kept
Gaffer, you promised me something. Nothing has happened. I want to know whether your word still counts.
Gaffer, I've waited, as we agreed. The promise hasn't been honoured. That disappoints me.

egoist: Gaffer, you promised me something and didn't keep it. That's no way to treat me. I'll draw my own conclusions.
kumpel: Gaffer, I believed you and defended you in front of the others. Now I look a fool. What am I supposed to make of that?
heisssporn: Gaffer, you promised me to my face, and nothing has come of it. I won't be strung along!
vorbildprofi: Gaffer, I've done my part. Your promise is still outstanding. I'd ask for an honest explanation.
diva: Gaffer, I'm not used to being promised something and then forgotten. That shouldn't happen with a player of my standing.
anfuehrer: Gaffer, you haven't kept your word to me. That's not just my business: the dressing room is watching closely how you handle promises.

standard: You're right. I'll put it right, and straight away.
The situation has changed. I couldn't keep it, and I'll tell you openly why.
I didn't guarantee you anything. On the pitch, whoever deserves it plays.
Good. I won't wait a second time, though.
I'm not happy. But at least you're telling me straight.
So that's how it is. Then I know what your word is worth.
{spieler_kurz} wants to leave the club
Gaffer, I've thought long and hard. I see no future for myself here any more and want to leave the club.
Gaffer, I'll tell you straight: I want to move. I'm asking you to agree to a transfer.

egoist: Gaffer, I'm wasting my time here. I want out, and to a club that knows what it has in me.
kumpel: Gaffer, this is hard for me because I like the lads. But I can't go on like this. I'd like to make a fresh start somewhere else.
heisssporn: Gaffer, I've had enough, finally. I want out. Put me on the transfer list.
vorbildprofi: Gaffer, I'd like to ask you to allow a move. Until then I'll honour my contract and train as always.
diva: Gaffer, I've watched this long enough. A player like me belongs on a bigger stage. I want to go.
anfuehrer: Gaffer, I've always taken responsibility here. If I'm asking for a move now, it's not done lightly. Let's sort this out properly.

standard: I won't stand in your way. If a suitable offer comes in, you can go.
I want to keep you. Tell me what has to change for you to stay.
You have a contract, and you'll honour it. A move is out of the question.
Thanks, gaffer. Until then I'll give everything for the team.
We can talk about that. But actions have to follow.
Noted. It won't make anyone happy here.
